subject: Coordinate next technical walkthrough — confirm attendee roster & Meet link

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & proposed timebox for technical walkthrough

Hi Claire / Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposal for next steps: 

- Recap: you want a short, 45-min technical walkthrough focused on (1) infra requirements for deploying models, (2) latency/cost expectations for your 24/7 inference use case, and (3) integration points (auth, VPC).
- Goal of the walkthrough: land on a POC scope, owners, and next checkpoints (POC timeline + success criteria).

Proposed 45-minute slots (Pacific):
- Thu Dec 31, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Mon Jan 3, 9:30–10:15 AM PT
- Tue Jan 4, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Please confirm which slot works best and who from your side will join (roles are helpful: infra, product, security). I’ve cc’d Marissa (product) and Ben (solutions infra) so they can own the demo content and infra checklist.

Attached: initial-discovery-notes.txt (short call notes).

Thanks — I’ll draft a focused agenda once we lock a slot.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks — locking Mon Jan 3, 9:30–10:15 AM PT. Sending calendar invite below and attaching a concise agenda.

Agenda (45m):
1) 5m quick intros + success criteria
2) 15m infra & deployment (Ben) — latency/cost tradeoffs
3) 15m integration & security (Irene) — VPC/KMS/auth patterns
4) 5m POC scope & owners (Marissa/Karthik)
5) 5m next steps + open Qs

Google Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh
Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Agenda.pdf (pdf) — short, timeboxed agenda
Other prep: sample traffic sketch + service account note (one-pager included in attachment).

Action items / owners for the meeting:
- Marissa Cole (product): draft success criteria + sample prompts to test
- Ben Carter (solutions infra): prepare infra diagram and expected throughput numbers
- Irene Choi (security): bring KMS/VPC checklist and compliance constraints
- Claire / Samir (Starhill): confirm Rajesh’s attendance and any access we should prep before the call

If anything should change on the roster, reply all and we’ll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

— Karthik
